details: In the current build of VRChat (2018.4.4p3), avatars will not load if they were previously blocked and the user attempts to unblock them either by changing their safety settings or force-enabling avatars on a per-user basis. They will remain in blue loading man form until that person changes their avatar at any point.
title: Avatars do not load after unblocking them
